tok 1.0 "Acquisition of potential customers"

pool company "Sales company"
  lane marketing "Marketing staff"
    start begin "Contact details needed"
    xor source "Where do the contact details come from?"
    task buy "Buy details for cold calls"
    task exhibit "Participate in exhibitions"
    task acquaintance "Learn of a customer through an acquaintance"
    xor sourced "Contact details obtained"
  lane callcenter "Call center staff"
    task call "Call the customer"
    task determine "Determine the contact person and the budget"
    task ask "Ask whether the customer is generally interested"
    xor interested "Customer generally interested?"
    xor huge "Potential project budget huge?"
    end left "Customer left alone"
  lane head "Head of development"
    task acquire "Personally acquire the customer"
    xor endInterest "Customer interested in the end?"
    xor ready "Customer ready for presentation"
  lane sales "Sales representative"
    xor presType "Presentation type?"
    task detailed "Give detailed online presentation"
    xor presMerge "Presentation given"
    eventgw wait "Customer comes back within 2 weeks?"
    catch contacted "Customer contacts us" message="Customer contact"
    catch timeout "2 weeks passed" timer=P14D
    task callBack "Call the customer back"
    xor joined "Customer reached"
    task quote "Create a quotation"
    end done "Quotation created"
  lane preSales "Pre-sales employee"
    task techPres "Give technical online presentation"

flow begin -> source
flow source -> buy -> sourced
flow source -> exhibit -> sourced
flow source -> acquaintance -> sourced
flow sourced -> call -> determine -> ask -> interested
flow interested -> ready "yes"
flow interested -> huge "no"
flow huge -> acquire "yes"
flow huge -> left "no"
flow acquire -> endInterest
flow endInterest -> ready "yes"
flow endInterest -> left "no"
flow ready -> presType
flow presType -> detailed "detailed"
flow presType -> techPres "technical"
flow detailed -> presMerge
flow techPres -> presMerge
flow presMerge -> wait
flow wait -> contacted
flow wait -> timeout
flow contacted -> joined
flow timeout -> callBack -> joined
flow joined -> quote -> done
